u.english: Well, if you have sworn, then you must keep your word.

target.text: Se fizeste uma jura tens de cumprir a palavra.

translation.text: Well, if you have sworn, then you must keep your word.

u.target: Se fizeste uma jura tens de cumprir a palavra.

u.english: - Stop thy tears and swear by silence.

target.text: Para de chorar e jura o teu silêncio.

translation.text: - Stop thy tears and swear by silence.

u.target: Para de chorar e jura o teu silêncio.

u.english: Do you swear or affirm to tell the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth?

target.text: Jura dizer a verdade e nada mais que a verdade?

translation.text: Do you swear or affirm to tell the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth?

u.target: Jura dizer a verdade e nada mais que a verdade?

m.english: I know what you took with you into that cell.

target.text: Sei o que levaste contigo para aquela cela.

translation.text: I know what you took with you into that cell.

forced_selection.sense_id: en-levar-pt-verb-pt:to move something to a destination|pt:to accompany

m.target: Sei o que levaste contigo para aquela cela.

m.english: Like the kids that got killed in that movie you took me to.

target.text: Como os miúdos que foram mortos naquele filme a que me levaste.

translation.text: Like the kids that got killed in that movie you took me to.

forced_selection.sense_id: en-levar-pt-verb-pt:to move something to a destination|pt:to accompany

m.target: Como os miúdos que foram mortos naquele filme a que me levaste.

m.english: You took my husband, my world, and my happiness.

target.text: Levaste o meu marido, o meu mundo, a minha felicidade.

translation.text: You took my husband, my world, and my happiness.

forced_selection.sense_id: en-levar-pt-verb-pt:to remove from the rightful place or owner|pt:to kill

m.target: Levaste o meu marido, o meu mundo, a minha felicidade.

m.english: When you got shot, what really happened?

target.text: Quando levaste o tiro, o que aconteceu?

translation.text: When you got shot, what really happened?

m.target: Quando levaste o tiro, o que aconteceu?

m.english: Hey, you ever been whacked in the head full force with a chair leg?

target.text: Já levaste com uma perna de cadeira na cabeça com toda a força?

translation.text: Hey, you ever been whacked in the head full force with a chair leg?

m.target: Já levaste com uma perna de cadeira na cabeça com toda a força?

m.english: Or the people you work for, they're going to hear all about how you led us to their money.

target.text: Ou as pessoas para quem trabalhas vão ouvir tudo, sobre como nos levaste ao dinheiro.

translation.text: Or the people you work for, they're going to hear all about how you led us to their money.

m.target: Ou as pessoas para quem trabalhas vão ouvir tudo, sobre como nos levaste ao dinheiro.

m.english: You've never taken my hypothesis seriously, Except.

target.text: Nunca levaste a sério a minha hipótese, Salvo.

translation.text: You've never taken my hypothesis seriously, Except.

m.target: Nunca levaste a sério a minha hipótese, Salvo.

m.english: How long did this take you?

target.text: Quanto tempo levaste a fazer isto?

translation.text: How long did this take you?

m.target: Quanto tempo levaste a fazer isto?

u.english: W-When? What were you really doing when you were supposed to be taking me to the doctor?

target.text: O que foste fazer quando disseste que me levaste ao médico?

translation.text: W-When? What were you really doing when you were supposed to be taking me to the doctor?

u.target: O que foste fazer quando disseste que me levaste ao médico?

u.english: So, you got beat up by a girl?

target.text: Com que então, levaste pancada de uma rapariga.

translation.text: So, you got beat up by a girl?

u.target: Com que então, levaste pancada de uma rapariga.
